newsitem.title: USA: Digi names European head, targets growth.
newsitem.headline: Digi names European head, targets growth.

text.p: Data communications firm Digi International Inc said it hired David Allen as managing director of its European operations, charging him with accelerating the company's growth there.
Allen had been general manager of Europe, Middle East and Africa for LAN products manufacturer, Thomas-Conrad Europe Ltd until its sale to Compaq Computer Corp in December 1995.
Allen will be based in Cologne, Germany, Digi's European headquarters, and will be responsible for directing the company's growth in Europe. Digi has operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
Allen reports to Robert Poorman, a Digi vice president, who ran the company's international operations from the company's headquarters in Minneapolis.
Shares of Digi, which provides data communications hardware and software to connect multiusers, remote access, and LAN networks, fell 1-1/8 to 15-3/8.
